# BullMQ

> BullMQ is an open source background job and message queue. It is available natively for TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js and Bun), Python, Elixir, Rust, .NET and PHP, and runs on Redis (or compatible datastores such as Valkey and Dragonfly) and on PostgreSQL. All SDKs share the same data model, so producers and workers written in different languages can work on the same queues.

This is the index of the BullMQ documentation. Every page is also available as Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL, and [llms-full.txt](https://docs.bullmq.io/llms-full.txt) contains all the pages except the changelogs in a single file.

## Overview

- [What is BullMQ](https://docs.bullmq.io/index.md): General description of BullMQ and its features
- [Quick Start](https://docs.bullmq.io/quick-start.md): This is a basic guide to get your first queue working.
- [API Reference](https://docs.bullmq.io/api/)

## Python

- [Introduction](https://docs.bullmq.io/python/introduction.md): BullMQ is available as a native Python package, running on Redis™ or PostgreSQL.
- [Flow Producer](https://docs.bullmq.io/python/flow-producer.md): FlowProducer docs are maintained in the shared tabbed Flows guide.
- [Job Scheduler](https://docs.bullmq.io/python/job-scheduler.md): Job scheduler docs are maintained in the shared tabbed scheduler guide.
- [Lock Manager](https://docs.bullmq.io/python/lock-manager.md): Lock-renewal and cancellation behavior is documented in shared worker sections.
- [Global Concurrency and Rate Limit](https://docs.bullmq.io/python/global-concurrency-and-rate-limit.md): Global limits docs are maintained in the shared queue guide sections.
- [Job Cancellation](https://docs.bullmq.io/python/job-cancellation.md): Job cancellation docs are maintained in the shared worker guide section.
- [Queue Events](https://docs.bullmq.io/python/queue-events.md): Queue events docs are maintained in the shared events guide section.

- [Introduction](https://docs.bullmq.io/rust/introduction.md): BullMQ is available as a native Rust crate with full async/await support.
